experiment_data.hypothesis: In MiniHack permadeath navigation environments, episode-level counterfactual analysis will reveal death dominance (internal DR significantly > deterministic DR), validating the diagnostic framework's cross-environment applicability beyond ScienceWorld. This tests whether death avoidance as the dominant routing signal is a general phenomenon of LLM agents in irreversible-failure environments, not an artifact of ScienceWorld's specific task design.
